respuesta.razonamiento: Merged components from visual reading and narration. Biologists/clients ([icon] person) and hospitals ([icon] hospital) upload medical imaging data to an Amazon S3 ingestion bucket. Amazon EKS accesses images for visualization in the application, while Amazon SageMaker runs model training using Amazon FSx for high-performance storage. SageMaker exports models and results to a second Amazon S3 bucket (HDS compliant), which is then consumed by the EKS application. IAM was dropped per Rule 7 as it represents security/permissions configuration rather than a runtime flow. Docker was omitted as a standalone node per Rule 8 since it is the container runtime within EKS and SageMaker.
respuesta.nombre: Medical Imaging Processing and ML Architecture with SageMaker and EKS
